page_title: LIL 3-4 LYO | Lille v Lyon 06/05/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+8' Lyon quickly take the free kick with a short pass.
90+5' The actual number of corner kicks in this match – 4:4.
90+3' Leny Yoro (Lille) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Benoit Bastien had an easy-decision to make.
90+1' 3 - 4 Mama Balde (Lyon) heads the ball inside the right post after a splendid cross. This timely header produces a wonderful moment.

90+1' Bafode Diakite (Lille) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his strike from the penalty spot wasn't accurate enough and the ball went a few inches wide of the right post.
90' We will have 7 min. of added time.
88' 3 - 3 Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) finds some space inside the box to meet a beautiful cross and fires the ball into the top left corner. What a special shot.

85' 3 - 2 Goal! The ball is swung into the box from the resulting corner kick and finds Bafode Diakite (Lille), who jumps highest and tries his luck with a header from around the penalty spot. His effort is both strong and precise enough to go into the middle of the net. The score changes to 3:2.
85' Angel Gomes (Lille) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
82' 2 - 2 Fantastic team goal! Malick Fofana (Lyon) was set free in the area by Mama Balde and fired past Lucas Chevalier. 2:2.
80' Hakon Arnar Haraldsson (Lille) gets a yellow card.
79' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Ernest Nuamah leaves the pitch and Mama Balde (Lyon) comes on.

77' Ainsley Maitland-Niles (Lyon) attempts to score as he rises near the penalty spot and heads the ball to the middle of the goal. Lucas Chevalier pulls off a comfortable save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
75' We are about to witness a substitution. Alexsandro (Lille) is replacing Edon Zhegrova.
71' Rayan Cherki (Lyon) misses a big chance as his shot goes wide of the left post.
68' Pierre Sage has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Rayan Cherki replacing Nemanja Matic (Lyon).
68' Malick Fofana (Lyon) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Said Benrahma.
67' We are about to witness a subsitution. Orel Mangala (Lyon) for Corentin Tolisso.

66' No offside! Referee Benoit Bastien points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. That prompts big celebrations from the Lyon players. Said Benrahma (Lyon) smashes the ball into the top right corner of the goal to give the goalkeeper absolutely no chance of making a save!
65' Wait! Referee Benoit Bastien immediately makes the VAR signal, most likely to see if there was an offside in the build-up play.
65' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Said Benrahma (Lyon) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
64' Lyon failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
64' The resulting set piece from Lyon is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
63' The goalkeeper dives to deny Ernest Nuamah (Lyon), whose promising shot was aimed towards the left post.
61' Anthony Lopes leaps to collect the ball from the corner which was sent over by Edon Zhegrova (Lille).
60' Lille hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
58' Paulo Fonseca is forced to make a change. Gabriel Gudmundsson (Lille) is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Remy Cabella.
57' Gabriel Gudmundsson (Lille) is able to continue to play.
56' Gabriel Gudmundsson (Lille) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
54' Good clearance! Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) receives a brilliant short pass and finds himself in a good position inside the box, but he's robbed of the ball by one of the defending players.
52' Clinton Mata (Lyon) is penalised for holding. Benoit Bastien signals a set piece.
51' Ernest Nuamah (Lyon) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery.
47' The game is interrupted now, Gabriel Gudmundsson (Lille) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
47' Clinton Mata (Lyon) commits a rough foul. Benoit Bastien stops the game and makes a call.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Pierre Sage gives a chance to Ainsley Maitland-Niles and Nicolas Tagliafico (Lyon) is off.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' Said Benrahma (Lyon) received a clever through ball which could have put him in a promising position, but the defence was alert to the danger.
45+1' The corner from Said Benrahma (Lyon) is intercepted by Lucas Chevalier.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
43' Said Benrahma (Lyon) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
41' Lyon enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
37' 2 - 0 What a beauty from just outside the box! Edon Zhegrova (Lille) lashed the ball with incredible pace and power into the bottom right corner.
35' Ernest Nuamah (Lyon) picks up a yellow card for an infringement.
34' Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) gets in a good position inside the box and is only inches away from getting on the end of a through ball from the edge of the area.
32' What a miss! A floated cross from the flank picks out Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) unmarked near the penalty spot with just the keeper to beat, but he skies his header miles over the bar.
31' Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
28' Angel Gomes (Lille) has tested the patience of referee Benoit Bastien and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
27' Lille earn a corner.
27' Edon Zhegrova (Lille) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the bottom left corner, but Anthony Lopes easily deals with the threat.
26' Yusuf Yazici is being substituted because of an injury. Paulo Fonseca sends Edon Zhegrova (Lille) on the pitch.
25' Yusuf Yazici (Lille) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
23' Ernest Nuamah (Lyon) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.

21' 1 - 0 Perfectly taken free kick! Yusuf Yazici sends the ball in, Bafode Diakite (Lille) manages to jump highest near the penalty spot and plants a bullet header into the top right corner. It's 1:0.
20' Ismaily (Lille) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle.
18' Lille are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.
14' Benoit Bastien has a clear sight and sees a foul from Alexandre Lacazette (Lyon).
12' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Lyon, is overhit and the ball goes out of play.
11' Benoit Bastien blows his whistle. Angel Gomes (Lille) commits a foul after dangerous play.
10' Yusuf Yazici (Lille) got on the ball on the edge of the box and blazed a first-time shot well over the bar.
9' The ball goes behind for a corner. Lille will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
9' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Lille, is intercepted by one of the defenders.

8' Ernest Nuamah (Lyon) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Benoit Bastien with no other option than to blow for a foul.
5' Jonathan David (Lille) gets on the end of a pass and produces a promising first-time shot towards the bottom left corner. His effort is blocked by Anthony Lopes with a brilliant diving save!
4' Said Benrahma (Lyon) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Lucas Chevalier intercepts the ball.
3' Angel Gomes (Lille) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
2' Lille control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Lyon will kick the game off.
Benoit Bastien will referee today's match.
Show lineups You can have a look at the starting XIs of both teams in the details of this match.
